newsitem.title: NORWAY: Benor buys Japanese clean product vessel.
newsitem.headline: Benor buys Japanese clean product vessel.

text.p: Norway's Benor Tankers has agreed to buy the Japanese built and owned m/t Ace Trader for $21.575 million, according to a statement on the Oslo bourse.
The 60,961 deadweight tonne vessel, built in 1987, is an identical sister ship to Faith IV, which Benor acquired in 1993.
Benor said it would take over the vessel, which trades in the clean large range spot market east of Suez, by the end of July. It will be renamed as Trader.
After the acquisition, Benor will have four units operating in this sector, three of which are on period to Yukong.
The company's updated fleet list will show by the end of July interests in 24 tankers in operation and two under construction.
